resources.string: Checking the package on this phone…
This package is unavailable. Open versions to choose another one or check for updates.
Download the optional package for on-device recognition.
Waiting to start the download. You can leave this screen.
You can recognize a photo on this device. Check the result before saving.
The download could not finish. Check your connection and try again.
The files did not pass verification and will not be used. Remove the packages, then download them again.
The package could not be saved. Check available storage and try again.
The package is unavailable from the specified source. Try again later.
The package could not be prepared. Try again.
Only the package files are downloaded. Your photos are not sent anywhere.
The package is installed only after all files pass verification.
Android decides whether the network is metered.
All saved packages, including the previous version and unfinished installations, will be deleted. Your car records will remain. Packages can be installed again later.
A new version is available. Open versions to see what has changed.
Select a version, then enable it from the scanner card. Packages are never installed automatically.
You can select a version when the current operation finishes.
No versions are available yet. Check again later.
The version list is up to date.
Could not refresh the list. Check your connection and try again. Saved versions remain available.
The new version list did not pass verification. The saved list is still shown. Try again later.
The version list is out of date. Refresh it before downloading a new package. Installed packages remain available.
Could not save the version list. Check available storage and try again.
The version list is temporarily unavailable. You can select the original version or a package already saved on this phone.
This is a preview version. Recognition results may contain more errors.
The current version will remain available until the new package has been checked and installed.
The saved files will be checked before switching versions. No download is needed.
The previous package is already on this phone. Its files will be checked before switching. Your car records will remain.
